name: Ari Lennox
notes: Dreamville's soul voice and "the lane's most explicitly Badu-descended 2019+ artist". The entry flags her as "a legitimate cede to `trap-soul`… she is the one artist in this section whose low end is a genuine 808", and she is entried here because the harmony and the vocal placement are Badu-descended — so this model carries the strongest 808 of the seven that have one: `drums.bass808` with role **counter_riff**, a slide probability of 0.14 across P5/P8/m3 and light distortion, matching "a real 808/sub… with a long decay and occasional slides". Role `counter_riff` rather than `bassline` is deliberate: "played bass appears on the band-tracked material", and role `bassline` would silence the bass generator entirely. ⛔ `kick.lockTo808` is authored here at **0.8** and it has to be: `neo-soul` pairs `bass808: null` with `lockTo808: 0`, and the engine reads that lock as how many of the kick's own onsets the 808 rides — so inheriting the parent's zero silenced this model's 808 completely (`bass808.rs`: "ari-lennox seed 0: no 808 at all"). A model that adds an 808 over a genre that has none must state the lock itself. ⚠ INFERRED, and taken from `trap-soul`'s own 0.8 rather than picked, because the research calls her "the section's closest neighbour to `trap-soul`" and says the sub is present "on much of her catalogue". Drums are "hip-hop-gridded but soft — kick on 1 and the 16th before 3, clap/snare on 2&4, swung 16th hats with occasional 32nd rolls, and a live-percussion overlay", so the kick is the most syncopated of the soft-programmed models here with the highest tresillo bias, and the hat rolls are 32nds. Harmony is "m9/m11 colour and 2-to-4-bar cycles; jazz-club voicings (root-7th-9th-11th) on Rhodes, plus a habit of holding a single sonority under a whole verse" — no families, the lowest triad weight in this batch and long chord durations. Melody is "warm alto, conversational, moderate note-density, with a Badu-style behind-the-beat lag and blues-scale ornament", which is the moderate density, a mid `chordToneBias` and a raised `halfStepDissonance`. ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are every drum number, the 808 values and all melody figures; the research marks the whole parametric detail as inference.
